sentences.en: The police believe the murder was a calculated crime.
sentences.zh: 警方认为这是一起有预谋的犯罪。

sentences.en: Robbing a bank is always seen as a calculated crime.
sentences.zh: 抢劫银行总是被视为有预谋的犯罪。

sentences.en: The theft of the priceless artifact was clearly a calculated crime.
sentences.zh: 这件无价文物被偷显然是经过精心策划的犯罪。
